overview: A modern single-page marketing website for Lutix DeepTech, a Madurai-based software and AI startup, with a working enquiry form that stores submissions and emails the team.
features: Sticky navigation with smooth-scroll to Home, About, Services, Why Us and Contact
Hero section with headline, calls to action and a technology visual
About section with company story, mission and key facts
Services cards for software development, AI solutions, web and mobile apps, automation and digital transformation
Enquiry form that validates input, saves submissions and emails the team
Responsive layout with mobile menu and hover and focus transitions
